content.short: AFI Protocol runs proof-of-reserve vaults paying yield backed by gold and other real assets.
content.description: AFI Protocol operates vaults backed by real assets including gold, with proof-of-reserve attestations covering what sits behind them. For any commodity-backed token the attestation is the product, since the token is only worth what can actually be redeemed against it.
content.meta: Gold-backed and real-asset vaults on Monad, published with proof-of-reserve attestations.
